spotinfo.txt: This is a demo of a new hotspot mode that supports scrolling content, responsive positioning, optional browser window centering and external third-party embeds. To use this mode, select "Rotating indicator with content in lightbox popup" on the first tab of the Hotspot form and use Text Content tab to either add your text (supports HTML) or a third-party embed URL that you can enter via a dedicated button in the toolbar of the Text Content tab.
